name: youtube-translate
description: Transcripts, translations, summaries, subtitles, and timestamped search for public YouTube videos.

interface.shortDescription: Transcripts, translations, and summaries for YouTube.
interface.longDescription: Get reliable transcripts from public YouTube videos, including videos without usable captions. Translate transcripts, generate SRT or VTT subtitles, summarize in three lengths, and search inside a video with timestamps. Cached public videos are free to read. Uncached processing requires an explicit spending approval and prepaid credits.
defaultPrompt: Get a timestamped transcript of this YouTube video.
Translate this YouTube video into Spanish and make subtitles.
Summarize this YouTube video and find the part about pricing.
